# The 5E Teacher

> A comprehensive resource for implementing the 5E instructional model in K-12 science and literacy education, featuring hands-on learning activities, classroom management strategies, and teacher advocacy.

Created by Nicole Fuhrman, this site showcases practical applications of the BSCS 5E model across multiple grade levels and subject areas, from elementary science to adult GED instruction. The blog combines classroom activities, professional reflections, and education policy advocacy.

## Key Topics

- 5E Model (Engage, Explore, Explain, Elaborate, Evaluate)
- Hands-on Learning
- Next Generation Science Standards (NGSS)
- Classroom Management
- Problem-Based Learning
- STEM Integration
- Student Engagement
- Lesson Planning
- Professional Development
- Teacher Advocacy
- Science Education
- Collaborative Learning
- Assessment and Rubrics
- Classroom Organization
- Education Reform

## Core Pages & Philosophy

- [The 5E Teacher – Homepage](https://takeachanceteach.wordpress.com): Homepage featuring Nicole Fuhrman's 5E teaching model and education advocacy.
- [What's With The Title?](https://takeachanceteach.wordpress.com/about): About page explaining 5E model development by BSCS and implementation.
- [A Little Philosophizing](https://takeachanceteach.wordpress.com/a-little-philosophizing): Instructional strategies and philosophy on 5E model implementation.

## Science Lessons & Activities

- [Classroom Instruction](https://takeachanceteach.wordpress.com/classroom-instruction): Science activities and hands-on learning examples using 5E model framework.
- [A Problem Based Learning Unit: Ecosystems](https://takeachanceteach.wordpress.com/2014/11/13/a-problem-based-learning-unit-ecosystems): NGSS-aligned problem-based learning unit on ecology and ecosystems.
- [Animal Adaptations Web Quest & Research Assignment](https://takeachanceteach.wordpress.com/2015/02/20/animal-adaptations-web-quest-research-assignment): NGSS-aligned middle school research assignment on natural selection.
- [Save Fred](https://takeachanceteach.wordpress.com/2014/09/12/save-fred): Engineering-based hands-on activity for elementary science and problem-solving.
- [Invasive Species: Integrating Science and Art with iMovie](https://takeachanceteach.wordpress.com/2016/02/23/invasive-species-integrating-science-and-art-with-imovie): STEM integration project using iMovie for invasive species research.
- [Mini-Unit: Nutrition](https://takeachanceteach.wordpress.com/2015/03/25/mini-unit-nutrition): Health curriculum lesson plan on nutrition using MyPlate framework.

## Classroom Management & Organization

- [Getting To Know Your Students](https://takeachanceteach.wordpress.com/2014/11/19/getting-to-know-your-students): Teacher strategies for building student relationships and classroom management.
- [2015 Classroom Set Up: Posters, Signs, & Management Strategies](https://takeachanceteach.wordpress.com/2015/09/20/2015-classroom-set-up-posters-signs-management-strategies): Classroom management techniques and setup strategies for high school science.

## Assessment & Instructional Tools

- [Rubrics and What Not](https://takeachanceteach.wordpress.com/2015/02/02/rubrics-and-what-not): Assessment tools and rubrics for standardizing elementary science curriculum.
- [A Book of 5th Grade Science Memories](https://takeachanceteach.wordpress.com/2014/06/23/a-book-of-5th-grade-science-memories): End-of-year memory book project for student reflection and celebration.

## Cross-Curricular & Literacy Instruction

- [(Auto)Biography Project](https://takeachanceteach.wordpress.com/2015/03/10/autobiography-project): Adult education and GED writing assignment using biography research.
- [Life Lessons From Critical Literary Theory, New England Wampanoags, and 'Fish Is Fish'](https://takeachanceteach.wordpress.com/2012/06/24/life-lessons-from-critical-literary-theory-new-england-wampanoags-and-fish-is-fish): Critical literacy and literary theory approaches for high school English.
- [Help, I Think I'm Sinking!: The Overwhelming Nature of Language Arts](https://takeachanceteach.wordpress.com/2012/06/16/help-i-think-im-sinking-the-overwhelming-nature-of-language-arts): Language arts curriculum planning and literacy instruction challenges.

## Teacher Advocacy & Professional Reflection

- [Bye Bye, Sick Days: A Response to State Senate Bill 229](https://takeachanceteach.wordpress.com/2017/02/20/bye-bye-sick-days-a-response-to-state-senate-bill-229): Teacher advocacy response to Pennsylvania Senate Bill 229 on sick days.
- [Great Professional Development — and No, I Don't Even Mean The Drinking Kind](https://takeachanceteach.wordpress.com/2012/10/23/great-professional-development-and-no-i-dont-even-mean-the-drinking-kind): Reflection on professional development and collaborative teacher growth.
- [Regrets: But I Can't Go Back, and I Don't Want To](https://takeachanceteach.wordpress.com/2013/03/27/regrets-but-i-cant-go-back-and-i-dont-want-to): Personal reflection on teaching career decisions and relocation experiences.
